## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and compatibility impact.

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results.

## Privacy and security

- [ ] Examples, tests, logs, and screenshots are synthetic or sanitized.
- [ ] No credential, session, database, private profile, personal data, or production identifier is included.
- [ ] External effects and legacy adapter changes are explicitly identified.

## Contribution attestation

- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer (`git commit -s`).
